change_summary: Replaced hardcoded grid (cdiv(xnumel,128), cdiv(ynumel,8)) with a dynamic lambda using meta['XBLOCK']/meta['YBLOCK'], and expanded autotune configs from 7 to 12 entries including XBLOCK=1024/YBLOCK=1 variants to enable the autotuner to actually explore different tile shapes and push waves/SM from 0.74 to ~11.
